parsed.why: Most-protective tier: care shield, gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime coverage since 1993, panic-defence repeal, easy marker change, no facility ban. Only documented harm is a dated 2012 custody placement; national border and custody regime still caps it.

Same top tier plus visitor-facing public-accommodations coverage (hotels, shops), mandated gender-neutral restrooms, and a care shield expressly covering interstate travellers; no documented anti-trans incidents. Resident-facing gaps and the national border regime remain.

Most-protective tier: 2026 care shield, broad anti-discrimination, gender-identity hate-crime coverage, abolished panic defence, X markers by request, no facility ban. No documented violence; national document/screening exposure unchanged.

No facility ban and a court-ordered coverage settlement, but minor care ban, an adult hospital halting surgeries, and a documented city pattern of lethal violence against trans women. Killing-rate figure is an acknowledged undercount floor, so unusable.

No facility statute or criminalisation, but no statewide non-discrimination or gender-identity hate-crime recourse, amended certificates must display original sex, care barred for minors and prisoners, bathroom bill revived in 2025.
